highlights: Major tech giants are deeply integrating AI into core products, with Google upgrading Search with Gemini 4 Hydrogen and launching Gemini for healthcare, while OpenAI simplifies enterprise access to ChatGPT via AWS Marketplace.

The landscape for AI agents is rapidly advancing, featuring AWS's release of an AI-built local emulator, Cogent and OpenAI's partnership on cyber defense agents, and CodeRabbit scaling software development with AI-generated code.

New powerful models and tools empower builders: Anthropic introduces Claude Fable/Mythos 5.2 with varied safeguards, Google launches the Gemini Decisions API for multimodal inputs, and Hugging Face integrates LLMON for structured LLM interaction.

agents.title: AWS Releases AI-Built Local AWS API Emulator
agents.summary: AWS launched AWS Emulator, a free, CC0-licensed local emulator for over 200 AWS APIs, entirely coded by autonomous AI agents, enabling rapid offline development and testing of cloud applications.

agents.title: Cogent & OpenAI Partner on Enterprise Cyber Defense Agents
agents.summary: Cogent, in partnership with OpenAI, is developing "cyber defense factories" that use AI agents combined with enterprise context to automatically remediate vulnerabilities, significantly strengthening corporate security.

agents.title: CodeRabbit Scales Software Development with AI-Generated Code
agents.summary: CodeRabbit leverages OpenAI models, including Codex, to govern and trust AI-generated code, enabling engineering teams to scale agentic software development and ship products 20 times faster.

models.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 with Varying Safeguards
models.summary: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, a powerful new model with two safeguard levels and a 1M-token context window, offering flexibility for developers needing different safety thresholds.

models.title: Google Launches Gemini Decisions API for Multimodal Decisions
models.summary: Google introduced the Gemini Decisions API, powered by Gemini Decision 1, offering fast, calibrated multimodal decision-making for text, images, audio, video, and PDFs, providing probabilistic answers for complex questions.

models.title: MBZUAI Releases PAN 2: Open-Source 29B World Model for Physical AI
models.summary: MBZUAI's IFM released PAN 2, an Apache 2.0 open world model that combines an LLM planner with a 29B diffusion transformer to simulate up to 20 seconds of action outcomes as video, advancing physical AI.

tools.title: Google Launches Gemini Decisions API for Multimodal Decisions
tools.summary: Google introduced the Gemini Decisions API, powered by Gemini Decision 1, offering fast, calibrated multimodal decision-making for text, images, audio, video, and PDFs, providing probabilistic answers for complex questions.

tools.title: LLMON: New LLM-Native Markup Language in Granite 4.1 Models
tools.summary: LLMON, an LLM-native markup language, is now integrated into IBM's Granite 4.1 3B and 8B models, providing developers with a standardized and structured way to interact with and extract information from LLMs.

tools.title: Dharma Field Extractor: Structured Data from Any Document
tools.summary: Dharma AI's Field Extractor processes any document type, automatically identifying and structuring key information into JSON output, significantly streamlining data extraction and workflow automation.

companies.title: Google Search Upgrades with Gemini 4 Hydrogen Integration
companies.summary: Google Search has been globally upgraded with Gemini 4 Hydrogen, promising more helpful, visual, and intuitive responses, demonstrating Google's commitment to integrating advanced AI into its core user experiences.

companies.title: Google Cloud Launches Gemini for Healthcare to Automate Workflows
companies.summary: Google Cloud launched Gemini for healthcare, an industry-specific AI solution designed to unify clinical data and automate administrative workflows, aiming to reduce burnout and enhance operational efficiency in medical settings.

companies.title: ChatGPT Enterprise Now Available in AWS Marketplace
companies.summary: OpenAI has made ChatGPT Enterprise available through AWS Marketplace, simplifying procurement for businesses by leveraging existing AWS billing relationships and facilitating broader enterprise-scale adoption of advanced AI.

learning.title: Hugging Face Guide to Fine-Tuning 3D Generation Models
learning.summary: Hugging Face published a definitive guide for fine-tuning 3D generation models, providing comprehensive instructions and best practices for developers looking to customize and optimize these models for specific creative or industrial applications.

learning.title: OpenAI Academy Offers ChatGPT Workshops for Caregivers
learning.summary: OpenAI Academy is providing free, hands-on ChatGPT workshops in five U.S. cities, empowering caregivers with practical AI skills to streamline daily tasks and enhance personal efficiency.

learning.title: Google AI Quest: "Polar Peaks" on Mapping the Human Brain
learning.summary: Google's AI Quests program introduced "Polar Peaks," a new educational lesson focused on neuroscience and AI's role in mapping the human brain, offering insights into advanced AI literacy and scientific applications.
